description: Read-only facts for YOUR mapping proposal. what "projects" (tool): the Jira projects where the credentials can create issues, or the Azure DevOps projects the credentials belong to; ask the user which to map, never guess. what "fields" (tool, externalProject): both sides for the active SimplifyQA project — Jira issue types / Azure DevOps work item types with fields (key, type, required, allowed values, sync type) and statuses; every SimplifyQA module the integration screen offers with fields, types, required flags and list values; and the current configuration, which a proposal should start from. Fields whose sync type is "not supported" cannot be mapped. what "subprojects" (tool): which sub project ids of the active project already have a configuration and the Jira project each maps to (names come from sqa_query collection "subProjects"); for Jira each sub project can sync with its own Jira project (pass subProject to "fields"), for Azure DevOps sub projects are routed through the Sub project field. what "values" (field): every allowed value of one field on both sides, from the last "fields" lookup. SimplifyQA projects, sub projects, users, releases, sprints and modules are read with sqa_query, not here. Nothing is written.

externalProject.description: fields: Jira project key, or Azure DevOps project name

subProject.description: fields (Jira): SimplifyQA sub project name or id, to configure that sub project with its own Jira project instead of the whole project

tool.description: "jira" or "azure"; needed for projects and fields

name: integration_lookup
title: Look up integration metadata
